title: OpenRTB 2.6 SeatBid
description: A bid response can contain multiple SeatBid objects, each on behalf of a different bidder seat.

bid.description: Array of 1+ Bid objects each related to an impression.

seat.description: ID of the buyer seat on whose behalf this bid is made.

group.description: 0 = impressions can be won individually; 1 = impressions must be won or lost as a group.

ext.description: Placeholder for bidder-specific extensions to OpenRTB.
